tier1.text: The parietal bones belong to the brain case, which holds and protects the brain. The right and left parietal bones meet at the top of the skull. The joint where they meet is the sagittal suture, which does not move.

sentences.text: The parietal bones belong to the brain case, which holds and protects the brain.

quotes.quote: The brain case is formed by eight bones, the paired parietal and temporal bones plus the unpaired frontal, occipital, sphenoid, and ethmoid bones.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: brain case: portion of the skull that contains and protects the brain, consisting of the eight bones that form the cranial base and rounded upper skull
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The right and left parietal bones meet at the top of the skull.

quotes.quote: These are paired bones, with the right and left parietal bones joining together at the top of the skull.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The joint where they meet is the sagittal suture, which does not move.

quotes.quote: sagittal suture: joint that unites the right and left parietal bones at the midline along the top of the skull
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: A suture is an immobile joint between adjacent bones of the skull.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
